results_format.note: One results format for every check, extending site-audit/results/findings.json (version, generated_at, findings[]). Each result is one row.

fields.check: the check ID in the register (R01, RENDER, PATHS, LOAD…)
fields.item: what it checked: a route, a path id, an endpoint, a workflow or a service
fields.who: the account it ran as, where it matters
fields.target: the target, as the register states it at the time
fields.measured: the measured value (a time, a count, a status)
fields.evidence: a link to the run, the screenshot or the record
fields.finding: the f-… id when it fails (as findings.json has today)
